response.original_title: Tampons & Taxes: Or How to Play the Ole Boys Club and Win
response.overview: Six female South Carolina state senators unite across party lines to pressure male colleagues into repealing a tax on feminine hygiene products, in this upbeat, empowering tale of sisterhood and strategy.
response.tagline: When male legislators in South Carolina refuse to repeal a sexist state tax on menstrual hygiene products, the only women in the South Carolina State Senate cross party lines to fight back.
response.title: Tampons & Taxes: Or How to Play the Ole Boys Club and Win
